subject: The one mistake 90% of dog owners make first
preview_text: It's not about the food. It's about the one thing you're probably tracking wrong. And it's costing you results.
body_paragraphs: I was reviewing some anonymized data this morning and noticed a pattern. A pattern that makes my stomach sink. Most people who start a weight loss plan for their dog focus on one thing: cutting food. And they miss the secret lever that actually makes the whole thing work.

Here's the truth I discovered after helping over 110 dogs: the biggest predictor of success isn't the meal plan. It's the photo timeline. The 'before' photo. The one 90% of users skip because it feels awkward, or they think 'I'll just remember.' But you won't. Your brain plays tricks. In two weeks, you won't see the subtle changes. The slightly looser collar. The new spring in their step. Without that starting point, you're flying blind, and motivation evaporates.

That's why the 'Before/After Photo Timeline' in PupShape isn't a vanity feature. It's your secret weapon. It's the objective proof your brain can't argue with. It turns vague worry into visible victory. It's the single most powerful tool for staying the course, because on day 30, you can look back at day 1 and actually see you're winning.

Open the app right now. Before you do anything else, take the 'before' photo. Just one. It takes 30 seconds. Do it before you forget, or before another week slips by. This one small action changes everything. P.S. The dogs who use the photo feature are 3x more likely to hit their first weight milestone. Don't let your best friend be a statistic.
